summary: Invoice Duplicate Alert tested. Backend GET /api/rokad/invoice-check: 6/6 pytest pass (same party case/space-insensitive, exclude_id, other party -> [], blank inv -> [], partial and regex '.*' don't match, auth required). UI (Playwright, 1920x1080): entry #1 INV-501/500 saved with no warning; typing 'inv-501' shows inv-dup-warning ('19-10-2026 · ₹500.00 Kharch · V.1 (CASH IN HAND)') plus a red border (rgb 183,28,28); clearing the field or typing INV-502 hides it; Save with a duplicate opens a confirm (mentions Invoice No. and 'Phir bhi save karein?'); Cancel = no POST and the form keeps inv/amount; OK = saved and modal closed; Ctrl+S Cancel/OK works the same way; a 3rd entry lists 2 duplicates; editing #1 excludes itself and lists #2 and #3; changing it to INV-999 clears the warning and saves (PUT, no confirm); party QA DUP 43B with INV-501 shows no warning; switching party to A while the form is open shows the warning; Esc closes the form; a fresh form after one with a warning has no stale warning. One bug: the guard can be skipped by a fast save (race with the 300ms debounce).

minor.issue: inv_no is not trimmed on save: 'INV-501 ' was stored with a trailing space. The check ignores spaces so the alert still works, but the stored and displayed values are untidy.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: the duplicate guard can be skipped. invDups is only set after the 300ms debounce plus the API round-trip. Repro: pick party QA DUP 43 (which already has INV-501), type amount 77, type Invoice No. 'inv-501' and press Ctrl+S right away. Result: no confirm, POST /api/rokad goes through and the duplicate entry is saved (V.4, ₹77). Pasting or fast keyboard entry hits this easily, so it defeats the purpose of the feature. The reverse also happens: invDups can still hold old hits after the user changes to a unique Invoice No., so a confirm can show up when it shouldn't.

action_items: HIGH: in submit(), when form.party_id and form.inv_no.trim() are set, await GET /rokad/invoice-check (party_id, inv_no, exclude_id=editId) and decide the confirm from that fresh result, not from the debounced invDups state. A cheaper option: track a 'checking' flag or the last-checked key (party|inv|editId) and re-check whenever it doesn't match the current form.
Minor: trim inv_no in the backend in create_rokad/update_rokad (or in the frontend payload).
critical_code_review_comments: InvoiceDupHint calls onResult([]) right away on clear, but when party_id or inv_no changes to another non-empty value, the parent's invDups keeps the old result until the debounce finishes. This stale state is the cause of the race above.
Backend regex uses re.escape plus \s* anchors, so it is safe against regex injection (verified with '.*'). There is no index on party_id+inv_no; fine at the current data size.
seed_data_creation: Created parties QA DUP 43 and QA DUP 43B, 4 rokad entries for 2026-10-19, and TEST_dupA/B fixtures in pytest. All deleted at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest the race: pick a party with an existing Invoice No., type the duplicate and press Ctrl+S within ~100ms. A confirm must still appear (dismiss -> no POST). Also check: change a dup Invoice No. to a unique one and save at once -> no spurious confirm. Use page.on('dialog') with asyncio.ensure_future handler. Party autocomplete: fill [data-testid=select-party] then click [data-testid=select-party-opt-<id>].
